Indian Standard

SPECIFICATION FOR 
ROPE GUIDE ROLLERS FOR HAULAGE ROPES OF BICABLE 
AERIAL ROPEWAYS FOR TRANSPORTATION OF GOODS 



1. Scope — Lays down the requirements for rope guide rollers for haulage ropes of bicable aerial 
ropeways for transportation of goods. 

1-1 This standard is applicable to rope guide rollers for haulage ropes and inline equipment for 
installations having a speed not exceeding 4'25 m/s.

2.3 Bearings— The ball bearings used in the manufacture of rollers shall conform to relevant 
Indian Standards. A list of Indian Standards on ball bearings is given in Appendix A. 

3, Material 

3.1 The hub shall be manufactured from steel St 42 of IS : 1570-1961 ' Schedules for wrought steels 
for general engineering purposes '. 

3.2 The ring shall be made from hardened alloy steel or any other lining as agreed to between the 
purchaser and the manufacturer. 

4. General Requirements 

4.1 All surfaces except bearing seatings shall be given treatment of stress relieving, pickling and 
phosphating and stove enamelling. 

4.2 The diametral runout (eccentricity) shall not exceed 0*8 mm at any point along the outer 
periphery. 

4.3 The ring shall be properly press fitted to ensure true fit. 

4.4 A grease nipple of size M10 x1 conforming to IS: 4009-1967 'Grease nippies' shall be fitted 
on the hub of the rollers for purpose of lubrication. 



IS =9413-1980 

4-5 Bolts of M12 size shall be used in the rollers for fixing. Anti-vibration nuts or check nuts shall 
be employed for fixing purposes. 

5. Designation — The guide roller of nominal size 300 shall be designated as: 

Guide Roller 300 IS : 9413 

6. Marking — The rollers shall be painted with the nominal size and manufacturer's name and 
recognized trade-mark. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



APPENDIX A 

( Clause 2.3 ) 

LIST OF INDIAN STANDARDS RELATING TO BALL BEARINGS 

IS: 

2398-1967 Identification code for roller bearings 

2898-1976 Steel balls for rolling bearings (first revision ) 

3090-1965 Code of practice for installation and maintenance of rolling bearings 

3823 ( Part I )-1966 Methods for evaluating static load ratings of rolling bearings: Part I Radial 

ball bearings 

3824 ( Part I )-1966 Methods of evaluating dynamic load ratings of rolling bearings: Part l Radial 

ball bearings 

4025-1967 Gauging practices for ball and roller bearings 

5669-1970 General plan of boundary dimensions for radial rolling bearings 

5934-1970 Chamfers and fillet radii for rolling bearings 

6453-1972 Technical supply conditions for rolling bearings 

6455-1972 Single row radial ball bearings 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

While preparing this standard considerable assistance has been derived from UNI 4900-1962 
' Sostegni semplici di linea per teleferiche bifuni-Rulli guidafune con anello e bussola ricambiabili ' 
(Simple supports for cableways with double cable guide pulleys with inter-changeable ring and 
collet ) issued by Ente Nazionale Italiano Di Uniflcazione, Milano.
